title: Joy & Gratitude
intro: The first year is exhausting and it is also the funniest, gladdest year most families ever have. This month is permission to enjoy it — to notice out loud, to be thankful in the middle of the mess, and to let a baby learn that delight is the normal weather of this house.

keyScriptures.text: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
He will take great delight in you... he will rejoice over you with singing.

weeks.title: Glad You Are Here
weeks.declaration: You are a reason to be glad. This house sounds different because you are in it, and we would not have it quiet again.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, thank You for the gladness this child has brought. Let us not be too tired to notice it. Amen.

weeks.title: Delighted In
weeks.declaration: You are delighted in, not merely managed. God is glad about you and so are we, on the good days and the long ones alike.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, let this child grow up knowing they are a delight rather than a duty. Amen.

weeks.title: Thankful in the Middle
weeks.declaration: The year is hard and it is good at the same time. Both are true and we will say both.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, make us thankful in the middle of it rather than only afterwards. Amen.

weeks.title: Laughter in This House
weeks.declaration: There is laughter here, and you are learning it. May it be one of your earliest memories.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, fill this house with laughter our child remembers when they are grown. Amen.

days.title: Glad You Are Here
days.declaration: You are a reason to be glad. This house is different because you are in it.

scripture.text: Children are a heritage from the Lord.

days.title: Today Was Made
days.declaration: This ordinary day was made on purpose, and you are in it.

scripture.text: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

days.title: God Is Glad About You
days.declaration: You are delighted in, not merely managed. God is glad about you.

scripture.text: He will take great delight in you.

days.title: Sung Over
days.declaration: You are sung over, badly and often. May you always be somebody's song.

scripture.text: He will rejoice over you with singing.

days.title: Your First Laugh
days.declaration: Your laugh changes a room. It is one of the best things God made.

scripture.text: A cheerful heart is good medicine.

days.title: Thankful for Small Things
days.declaration: Warm milk, a clean blanket, a hand to hold. Most of a good life is small.

scripture.text: Forget not all his benefits.

days.title: Good Gifts
days.declaration: Everything good in your life came from somewhere. You are surrounded by gifts.

scripture.text: Every good and perfect gift is from above.

days.title: Made to Enjoy
days.declaration: God did not have to make anything enjoyable. Delight was designed in.

scripture.text: God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.

days.title: Hard and Good Together
days.declaration: This year is hard and it is good. Both are true and we will say both out loud.

scripture.text: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord.

days.title: Noticing You
days.declaration: We are noticing you on purpose — the new sound, the new grip, the new look.

scripture.text: Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.

days.title: Joy That Is Not Earned
days.declaration: Nobody had to earn the joy you brought. It arrived with you.

scripture.text: I bring you good news that will cause great joy.

days.title: Enough Today
days.declaration: There is enough today. We do not need more than this to be glad.

scripture.text: Godliness with contentment is great gain.

days.title: Grateful for Your Body
days.declaration: Thank God for what your small body is doing every hour without being told.

scripture.text: I praise you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

days.title: Somebody Else's Gladness
days.declaration: Other people are glad about you too — grandparents, friends, strangers in shops.

scripture.text: Rejoice with those who rejoice.

days.title: Thank You Out Loud
days.declaration: We will say thank you out loud in front of you until you say it too.

scripture.text: Give thanks in all circumstances.

days.title: Joy Deeper Than Mood
days.declaration: There is a gladness underneath a hard day. May you learn to find it.

scripture.text: The joy of the Lord is your strength.

days.title: Remembering This Year
days.declaration: We will remember this year. Some of it we will forget, and it will still have shaped you.

scripture.text: I will remember the deeds of the Lord.

days.title: Not Comparing You
days.declaration: We are not comparing you to anyone. Your growing is yours and it is a joy.

scripture.text: Each one should test their own actions.

days.title: Gladness at the Door
days.declaration: May people be glad when you arrive, all your life. It starts with our faces now.

scripture.text: The Lord make his face shine on you.

days.title: A Full Table
days.declaration: There is enough at this table for you. There always will be.

scripture.text: You prepare a table before me.

days.title: Singing Anyway
days.declaration: We sing even when we are exhausted. You are learning that joy is a decision.

scripture.text: Come before him with joyful songs.

days.title: Gratitude Before Sleep
days.declaration: Naming one good thing before sleep is a habit worth having for eighty years.

scripture.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep.

days.title: New Mercy Each Morning
days.declaration: Every morning starts again, however the night went.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Given, Not Owed
days.declaration: You were given to us. Nobody was owed you, and that makes you better, not less.

scripture.text: The Lord has granted me what I asked of him.

days.title: Play Is Holy
days.declaration: Playing with you is not time off from something more important. It is the important thing.

scripture.text: The streets will be filled with boys and girls playing.

days.title: Thankful for Help
days.declaration: Thank God for everyone who has helped this year. We were not meant to do it alone.

scripture.text: Carry each other's burdens.

days.title: Gladness Is Contagious
days.declaration: Cheerfulness spreads. You are already changing the mood of rooms.

scripture.text: A cheerful look brings joy to the heart.

days.title: More Good Coming
days.declaration: This is not the last good thing that will happen. God has not run out.

scripture.text: No good thing does he withhold.

days.title: Joy Nobody Takes
days.declaration: There is a joy that cannot be taken from you, because nobody gave it.

scripture.text: No one will take away your joy.

days.title: Grateful for This House
days.declaration: Somewhere to belong is a real gift. Not everyone has one, and you do.

scripture.text: God sets the lonely in families.

days.title: Carrying the Gladness
days.declaration: The noticing we are practising now is a habit we will keep. It is for the years ahead.

scripture.text: Rejoice always.
